title: Local 3D sports sedan with cabin and selectable mechanical parts
summary: Replace the blocked embedded viewer with an original locally rendered educational vehicle, interactive panels and cockpit exploration.

changes.detail: Original 3D sedan with transparent glazing, four hinged doors, bonnet, boot, cabin furniture and dashboard, V8-style assembly, transmission, suspension, disc brakes, rims, tyres and connected systems.
Camera presets, cockpit entry, part selection with automatic cutaway, paint, modes and mobile presentation.
Automatic external Sketchfab SDK/embed loading from the default studio experience. Existing hosted-viewer source retained.
Default viewer no longer depends on third-party scripts/cookies. Quiz also offers text choices for occluded parts.

validation.name: Implementation validation
validation.detail: Build, typecheck, focused lint, interaction and visual checks pending. Geometry is original illustrative teaching content, not licensed BMW CAD; no native device testing or deployment.
